content: 1. Matrix Multiplication Fundamentals Matrix multiplication is a row-by-column binary operation. Two matrices A and B can only be multiplied if the number of columns in A equals the number of rows in B . If A has dimension m \times k and B has dimension k \times n , then the product C = AB has dimension m \times n .
